items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I met Louie when he came off the boat to join Joe Oliver in CHicago.

ctx.x: I had left him there with the C-melody.
But I mean now were you in New York when Louie came -- Louie Armstrong played with Fletcher?
Sure. I met Louie when he came off the boat to join Joe Oliver in CHicago.
